title: Tech 21 SansAmp PSA 2.0

x_pc.additionalInfo: 128 slots (49 factory, 79 user). Incoming PC numbers can be remapped to internal presets via Special Page Function 2. Special Page Function 3 switches 0–127 vs 1–128 numbering.

additionalInfo: 5-pin DIN MIDI IN. PC-only for preset recall — no MIDI CC parameter control. SysEx used for bulk dump backup/restore, not real-time control.
